SVG overlay on tachometer: 34 tick lines, 12 text elements (0-8 numbers, x1000r/min unit, VTEC, digital RPM)
SVG overlay on speedometer: 34 tick lines, 10 text elements (0,20,40,60,80,100,120,140,160 numbers, mph unit)

features_verified.details: Both gauges use SVG <image> tag with href pointing to PNG files. Tachometer: /assets/gauges/rpm-gauge.png, Speedometer: /assets/gauges/spd-gauge.png
Tachometer has SVG ticks (0-8), numbers, redline markers, VTEC text, digital RPM value, and rotating needle. Speedometer has ticks (0-160 in 20s), mph label, and needle.
RPM readout widget has fixed width: 130px and flexShrink: 0. Tachometer position remained stable (0px X difference) over 3 seconds of RPM value changes.
Red 'VTEC' text with glow filter appears inside tachometer when RPM >= 3000. Opacity varies with VTEC progress.
All 7 warning lights visible at bottom with borders, backgrounds, and readable text labels.
Left and right turn arrows are separate draggable widgets with data-testid='editable-turn-left' and 'editable-turn-right'.
Tachometer can be dragged independently in edit mode. Moved 80px successfully.
RPM readout widget [data-testid='editable-rpm-readout'] can be dragged independently.
Needle line uses CSS transform: rotate() with transition: 100ms ease-out. Has transformOrigin and willChange properties for smooth animation.
